audit_items.reason: KZG/DAS specification-level check. The specified code (zp_over_coset, coset evaluations) references ethereum/consensus-specs Python pseudocode. Erigon uses the external go-eth-kzg library which implements these cryptographic operations. The actual polynomial recovery logic is in the library, not the target codebase.

KZG/DAS specification-level check for division by zero error handling in recover_polynomialcoeff. The specified function is from ethereum/consensus-specs. Erigon delegates KZG operations to go-eth-kzg library.

KZG/DAS specification-level invariant check for coset_fft_field shift_factor constant. PRIMITIVE_ROOT_OF_UNITY is a cryptographic constant defined in the go-eth-kzg library implementation, not in this codebase.
KZG/DAS bit-reversal permutation (brp) verification in polynomial_eval_to_coeff, coset_for_cell, coset_shift_for_cell. These are cryptographic primitives implemented in go-eth-kzg library.
KZG/DAS divide_polynomialcoeff zero polynomial check. This function is part of the polynomial arithmetic in go-eth-kzg library.
KZG/DAS Lagrange interpolation xs distinctness validation in interpolate_polynomialcoeff. This is a cryptographic primitive in go-eth-kzg library.
KZG/DAS polynomial multiplication bounds check in multiply_polynomialcoeff. This is implemented in go-eth-kzg library.
KZG/DAS cell_index bounds validation in coset_shift_for_cell. This function is part of go-eth-kzg library's cell management.
KZG/DAS cell_index bounds and slice validation in coset_for_cell. This function is part of go-eth-kzg library.
KZG/DAS cell_to_coset_evals output cardinality and byte segment validation. This is a specification-level function implemented in go-eth-kzg library.
KZG/DAS roundtrip invariant test for coset_evals_to_cell(cell_to_coset_evals(cell)) == cell. This is a correctness property of go-eth-kzg library.
KZG/DAS _fft_field power-of-2 input validation. FFT implementation is in go-eth-kzg library.
KZG/DAS inverse FFT normalization factor 1/N correctness. FFT implementation is in go-eth-kzg library.

KZG/DAS compute_cells_and_kzg_proofs blob size validation. This is implemented in go-eth-kzg library. However, blob size validation at trust boundary is partially in cl/cltypes/beacon_kzgcommitment.go via BYTES_PER_BLOB constant.

Ommers validation is implemented in multiple consensus engines. Bor consensus (polygon/bor/bor.go:535) validates 'header.UncleHash != empty.UncleHash' returning errInvalidUncleHash. Clique consensus (execution/consensus/clique/verifier.go:86) has identical validation. Both engines enforce empty ommers for PoS/PoA chains. The validation occurs at header verification before block processing.

phase1_specification.property: Post-merge blocks must have empty ommers list (ommers_hash == EMPTY_OMMER_HASH)

phase3_verdict.notes: Validation correctly enforced at P2P boundary in both Bor and Clique consensus engines. Block with non-empty ommers is rejected before processing.

audit_items.reason: P2P peer ommers_hash validation is enforced through consensus engine verification. In polygon/bor/bor.go:535 and execution/consensus/clique/verifier.go:86, the validation 'header.UncleHash != empty.UncleHash' occurs in VerifyHeader which is called during block gossip processing. Blocks are validated before being forwarded to other peers or execution engine.

phase1_specification.property: P2P peer must validate ommers_hash equals EMPTY_OMMER_HASH before forwarding

phase2_implementation.validation_code: Ensure that the block doesn't contain any uncles which are meaningless in PoA

phase3_verdict.notes: Validation is performed in VerifyHeader which is invoked during P2P block processing, before forwarding.

audit_items.reason: Execution engine enforces empty ommers via block body validation in execution/types/block.go:602-604. The code 'if hash := CalcUncleHash(b.Uncles); hash != h.UncleHash { return fmt.Errorf(...) }' validates uncle hash consistency. CalcUncleHash (line 1402) returns empty.UncleHash for empty uncle list. Defense-in-depth is present: consensus layer validates header, execution layer validates body consistency.

phase1_specification.property: Execution engine must independently validate ommers are empty

phase3_verdict.notes: Block body validation ensures uncle list matches header hash. Empty ommers produce EMPTY_OMMER_HASH via CalcUncleHash.
